title: The Episode About the Wrestling Bout Between Miri Singh And Sangat Singh

blocks.text: A wrestling match is arranged at Akal Takht to decide the dispute physically after it has already been decided symbolically, turning factional struggle into embodied contest.
The outcome is rapid and public, with one side overpowered before the assembled community.
Akal Takht is the page’s defining anchor because the contest unfolds in the Panth’s central public space.
